shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Four vanilla-matched per-level sizes (126/190/250/300) and level counts are bought from a fixed 192,000-cell budget. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. Content on lower levels draws smaller once per level of drop, which is what makes a deep column read as depth.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §1-19 architecture; §20 compat library; §21-23 open items. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~72 files, ~20,600 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

## Pitch
Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED IN PLAY. **250 tier VERIFIED (#236); 190x5 VERIFIED (#237).**
UNVERIFIED: below-snow, depth shrink, camera anchor, §18 audit, reroll grid, VEE compat, GL roof fix, **the §24 mass-reach fix**.

**PUBLISHED-BUILD BUGS.**
1. Preview only worked at 190x190 - **FIXED** (§6d-CLAMP).
2. Fog/rocks regenerate on save reload - **NOT DIAGNOSED, HELD** (§21).
3. GL + rivers - **TABLED with a contradiction** (§22).
4. MO formations drawn 4x overlapping - **FIXED** (§24a).
5. **Rock only visible ONE level down** - **FIX SHIPPED, UNVERIFIED** (§24b). The most visible bug found so far.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. Bands stack along +z from the deepest basement, gutter between. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + MinGutter)/64)*64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample by world position).

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum, and `Reachability.CanReach` works unpatched. But reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**Hard 1.6 constraints.** Path grid is IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell, so total stacked cells is the runtime metric. No `PathFinder.FindPath`. `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

**⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Anything vanilla normalises by BOTH dimensions is distorted - a bug class that cannot appear on a square map.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, seven shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; random/edge cell; VEE Crater jitter | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline (§6e); VEE LoneIsland and Crater | re-centre the sample coordinate |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview (§6d); GL landform grids (§22) | generate at full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent, a margin off `Size` | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge; river WIDTH | re-base onto the cell's band rect |
| **Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims** | preview window and reroll grid (§6d) | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| **Map-wide scalar** | snow melt (§7), temperature readout (§16), GL roof sweep | rewrite it per cell at the consumer |
| **Foreign absolute writes** (§22) | GL landform output lands in band 0, our carve overwrites it | ORDER, not arithmetic |

Still unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley (all `FalloffAtAngle`).
**`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`, a `ModuleBase` wrapper for direct noise samplers.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN, budget 192,000 cells
**⚠ THE 64 CONSTRAINT IS ON *SLOT*, NOT BAND HEIGHT.** The original tiers were all 64k-2 - the tightest fit - and **that coincidence was mistaken for the requirement for months**.

| size | slot | gutter | cells/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| 190 | 192 | 2 | 36,480 | 99.0% | 5 | 182,400 ✅ #237 |
| **250** | 256 | 6 | 64,000 | 97.7% | 3 | **192,000** ✅ #236 |
| **300** | 320 | 20 | 96,000 | 93.8% | 2 | **192,000** |

250/300 are vanilla's Medium and Large exactly. **Budget is tuned:** 192,000 = `3 x 64,000` = `2 x 96,000`. Ladder 7/5/3/2; 350/382 not offered because a second level exceeds the whole budget.
**⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - just past the 192 boundary: slot 256, gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**⚠ A WIDE GUTTER IS A FEATURE** - "a spatial helper that reaches 22 rows will cross a 2-row gutter" is the root of §15a and §4.
**Old saves are safe** - `bandHeight` is scribed; `SlotFor` is generic. **`Size.x == bandHeight` is a repair tool.**
**⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES AND SILENTLY CONSTRAINS THE SIZE.** Levels must be reduced BEFORE a larger size is selectable. Read the PLAN line before believing any size test.
**⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.** Our radio buttons write `GameInitData.mapSize` directly - **the authoritative record of the choice.** **Adding a tier means growing the `InitialSize` postfix** (now +288f). **The chooser LATCHES global state, released in a `Finalizer`.**

# 3-5. MOVEMENT, ORDERING, DESCENT
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception; hops must strictly decrease. **Multi-hop UNTESTED IN PLAY.**
**Group ordering:** the drag line between bands runs through the GUTTER; the odd/even signature ("3 and 5 fail, 2 and 4 do not") is the proof - only ODD counts sample exactly 0.5.
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it. **NINE appearances of the single-step bug** - eight written as `- Slot` arithmetic, and **the ninth (§24b) written as a TERRAIN-DEF GATE with no `- Slot` in it at all**, which is why the standing grep audit could never have found it. **`TryResolveVisibleFrom` is THE gate.**

# 6. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION
Despeckle (walls dissolve only at 7+ open neighbours; at 6 it ate the outermost wall row off every meadow edge), central fog hole, five-terrain plateau palette, cliff faces, alpine pass.
**⚠ The mass tapers with altitude, so +3 may contain NO LAND AT ALL.** Quantified in #237's biome report: surface 12,723 plants / fertility 0.631; +1 248 / 0.069; +2 170 / 0.046; +3 **37 / 0.012**.
Ore glyph bug: ore defs have no `naturalTerrain`, so a "can't happen" fallback drew the whole atlas sheet per cell.

# 6a. ⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER
`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` ports vanilla `SectionLayer_Terrain` **and nothing else**. Confirmed twice: Water (§6b), Snow (§6f).
**⚠ THE CONVERSE IS HANDLED.** A foreign `Thing.Print` postfix prints into OUR layer and is still correct, because the call is bracketed `SnapshotVertCounts()` -> `Print` -> `FinishNewVerts`, and **`FinishNewVerts` transforms by VERTEX RANGE**. Preserve that.
**Multi-cell things:** `IsPrintAnchor` picks one anchor cell, but see §24a - it is drop-dependent and needed a dedupe.
**⚠ THE CAP IS SINGLE-STEP AND THAT HAS A VISIBLE COST.** `SectionLayer_ABMountainCap` derives from `-bands.Slot`, exactly one band down. That is correct for a sky band's own tapering mass, and it was recorded here purely as a design choice. **§24b is the cost:** nothing else drew rock mass deeper than one slot, so ground rock vanished from +2. The below layer now bridges past the cap's reach.
**Ascent rule:** the dirty mirror stops at the first opaque floor, tested over the cell and its eight neighbours; the FIRST step stays unconditional *because* the cap is single-step. Mirrors vanilla's `ProgramState` guard.
**⚠ THE UNIT OF WASTE IS A SECTION REGENERATION, NOT A CELL.**

# 6b-6g. WATER, PREVIEW, COASTS, SNOW, SHRINK
**Water** is a TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE effect; `SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen` targets `SubcameraDefOf.WaterDepth.LayerId`. Rivers remap `GetRiverCenter` (not `Init`); `GetLakeCenter` needs the same or it undoes the first. Width clamped at the producer. **⚠ ALL THREE INERT UNDER GL** (§22).
**Map Preview** builds a bare Map on a background thread, so our banding prefix never fires. Generate at full stacked height, crop via `TexCoords`.
**⚠ 6d-CLAMP, PUBLISHED BUG:** `Stacked()` ran the incoming size through `Clamp()`, which returns *the largest offered size ≤ input that fits*. Map Preview passes VANILLA's size (250 default), so `Clamp(250)` at 4 levels returned 190 **regardless of the player's pick**, and the crop check then rejected every tier except 190. **Fix: `PlannedSize`** - the chooser already wrote the answer to `GameInitData.mapSize`; it was never a derivation problem.
**⚠ MAP PREVIEW SHIPS IN TWO HALVES AND GL BUNDLES ONE.** `MapPreviewWindow`/`MapSeedRerollWindow` live ONLY in `MapPreviewMod.dll`. With GL installed and Map Preview absent, `Active` is TRUE while window types are ABSENT. **Do not "simplify" `Active` into a single gate.**
**6d-REROLL:** the window opened EMPTY - `elementSize.y = 403/126*896 = 2,866 px` -> `gridSize.y = 0` -> `DesiredCount = 0`. The SECOND consumer of the stacked size caught out by it.
**Coasts:** CENTRED wrong, not scaled wrong. NO SCALING. **⚠ "None override `GetNoiseValue`" is about VANILLA ONLY.**
**Below-snow (UNVERIFIED):** no mirror of `SectionLayer_Snow` existed. Near-miss: `CellTerrainAt` samples `snowGrid.GetDepth(below)` correctly but it feeds only `MaterialFor`'s pollution variant. #237 showed the layer present with `finalized=False disabled=True` on a 14.6C map - plausible (no snow), but needs a cold map.
**Depth shrink (UNVERIFIED):** **⚠ the atlas trap** - past `ZoomRootSize` 18 humanlikes render from a cached atlas blit ignoring `PawnDrawParms.matrix`. **⚠ Exclusions kept verbatim:** natural rock excluded BY DEF (`mineable`/`isNaturalRock`), not by link type, because Better Mountains swaps rock to non-linked `Graphic_Random` wholesale.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**

# 7-8a. CHARACTER, CAMERA
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))` scales `basementOreDensity` through our OWN `ABOreGen.ScatterOres`. **⚠ The snow line never worked, and the comment saying it did not need to was wrong.**
**The camera clamp and level-switch input share `ABGuard.Camera`**, both per-frame paths where an unthrottled `Log.Error` turns a cosmetic bug into a hang.
**New-game anchor:** only `StartedNewGame` runs after vanilla's own camera jump. ⚠ OPEN: `z=24` was EXACTLY `PodScatterMargin`.

# 9. GENERATION COST

## 9a. The profile stamps its own conditions
`ABGenProfile.Report` prints `TILE`, `PLAN`, `SCOPING:`, two censuses. Has voided or explained six comparisons.
**⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.** #231's answered for a map whose TILE/MUTATORS/PLAN it never printed. **Add them to `ABWaterBand.Report`.**

## 9b. ⚠ "COST IS DESTRUCTION NOT GENERATION" - NO LONGER TRUE, AND THE FIX IS WHY
#188: gensteps 3,972 / carve 20,447 / 74,584 destroyed (16/84). **#231: 3,836 / 1,580 / 4,575 (71/29).** Rock suppression worked, so the carve got cheap and cost moved to generation. **16/84 is a historical record of a fixed problem.**

## 9c-9f. Measured cost curve
| run | plan | cells | gensteps | carve | total | destroyed | suppressed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #231 | 7x126 Flat | 112,896 | 3,836 | 1,580 | ~5.7 s | 4,575 | 1,627 |
| #236 | 3x250 SmallHills | 192,000 | 5,001 | **7,118** | ~12.4 s | 15,611 | 7,272 |
| #237 | 5x190 Mountainous | 182,400 | 4,529 | 2,201 | ~6.9 s | 7,497 | **85,304** |

**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size:** 190 -> 36,480 cells -> 1,483 ms; 250 -> 64,000 cells -> 4,254 ms. **1.75x cells, 2.87x time**, exactly as the `ListerThings` linear-`List.Remove` mechanism predicts (a longer thing list makes every removal dearer).
**⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES THE BILL, NOT CELLS.** #237 has 95% of #236's cells and a third of its carve, because a mountainous tile SUPPRESSES rock (85,304) instead of destroying it (7,497 vs 15,611).
**⚠ THE 250 TIER IS THE EXPENSIVE ONE.** ~12.4 s vs ~5.7 s for 7x126. I recommended the 192,000 budget reasoning about PATHFINDING cost and did not predict generation time would double. Not a bug - inherent to a bigger map - but it makes §9g worth more than the estimates below, which were all measured at 126.

## 9g. ⚠ CORRECTION: THE PLANTS FINDING WAS WRONG TWICE
First claim: "~84% of the 2,270 ms is vegetation grown then erased." **FALSE.** I derived it from the doomed-CELL fraction and never read the census sitting in the same output. `DESTROYED by def` across #231/#236/#237 contains **no plant def in the top ten**, and the remaining defs share only a few hundred destroys. Plants are NOT bulk-erased; the cost is the **scan over stacked cells**, so the fix is "restrict the traversal to live bands", not §9d's "suppress the spawn".
Second claim: "biome-independent" from n=2. **Also false.** n=3 shows it tracks HILLINESS (open ground), not biome:

| tile | Plants |
|---|---|
| Flat, TropicalSwamp (#231) | 2,270 ms |
| SmallHills, TemperateForest (#236) | 2,225 ms |
| **Mountainous**, TemperateForest (#237) | **1,086 ms** |

Same biome as #236, half the cost. **~2.2 s is a Flat/SmallHills number, not a universal one.**
### Ranked
1. **`GenStep_Plants` traversal scoping** - 1.1-2.2 s depending on hilliness.
2. **Basement rock suppression** - ~1.2 s at 126, worth multiples of that at 250 (superlinear).
3. **`GenStep_RockChunks`** - `Filth_RubbleRock` is the top destroyed def in every run (2,462 / 7,531 / 2,260).
4. Scattered ruins (also a CONTENT BUG - the surface loses ruins vanilla intended).
5. `ABRockGen.PickIndex` Perlin precompute. NOT DONE: changes determinism.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT BENCHMARK MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ Bisect toggles PERSIST across runs.** Now STAMPED INTO THE PROFILE.
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry.** **n=5.** Keep padding with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ THE AUTO-PROMPT IS EDGE-TRIGGERED, SO CHECK THE COUNT, NOT THE TEXT.** A second water-report click produced no prompt; `monitor_get_error` returned the LATEST occurrence, which was still the FIRST - byte-identical and stale.
**⚠ Debug actions are `AllowedGameStates.PlayingOnMap`** - silently inert on the world map / preview screen.
**⚠ THE BELOW-LAYER REPORT WAS BLIND TO THE CAP UNTIL #237.** Its filter was `name.StartsWith("SectionLayer_ABBelow")`, which excludes `SectionLayer_ABMountainCap` - a layer that draws into the below view. **An omitted layer reads exactly like a layer that emitted nothing**, so the instrument invited the conclusion that the cap was innocent. Now `SectionLayer_AB`. **Audit a diagnostic's own filters before trusting a negative result from it.**

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify §24b** (rock visible at 2+ levels) - highest value, most visible bug found.
2. **§21 fog/rocks on reload** - the two-question observation.
3. **§9g plants traversal scoping** (re-scoped per the correction above).
4. Verify tiers 126/300; preview fix at 300; §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; depth shrink; camera anchor; below-snow (needs a COLD map).
5. Stamp TILE/PLAN into the water report.
6. Basement rock suppression; §9g 4-5; audit the other `FalloffAtAngle` mutators.
7. **Never exercised:** multi-hop stair router, elevator, basement PATHING/wormholes, cavern basement.
8. `ShotReport` drops target size. Biomes! at 40%. **Store page still says three levels.**
9. **§22 TABLED** - do not resume without re-reading the contradiction.

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Re-open a rejection only by naming the confound. Change one thing per experiment. Run the diagnostic before the third theory. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠ AUDIT THE INSTRUMENT'S FILTERS BEFORE TRUSTING A NEGATIVE.** The below-layer report excluded the cap by prefix, so "no cap line" looked like "the cap drew nothing". **A missing row and an empty row are indistinguishable in most diagnostics, and only one of them is evidence.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE BEFORE RUNNING THE EXPERIMENT.** #231's water report was clean and **worthless as a discriminator**: with `surfaceBand = 0`, "the river lands in band 0" and "the river lands on the surface" are THE SAME SENTENCE.
**⚠ A CENSUS BEATS A MAGNITUDE - AND I IGNORED MY OWN RULE.** The "84% of plant work is erased" claim came from a cell-count fraction while the `DESTROYED by def` census sat in the same log entry disagreeing with it. **When a measurement is already printed, do not compute an estimate of the same quantity.**
**⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN.** "Plants are biome-independent" survived exactly until the third tile. Two agreeing points invite a general claim; the third names the real variable.
**⚠ Measure the ratio before optimising the half you assumed - and RE-measure after.** Generation was 16% and is now 71% *because the fix worked*.
**⚠ Stamp the experiment's conditions into its own output** - and apply it to EVERY diagnostic, not just the one that taught you.
**⚠ THE SYMPTOM SET IS ITSELF EVIDENCE.** §21 named fog AND rocks and nothing else: exactly the two things stored as flat per-cell arrays sized by `map.Area`.
**⚠ CHECK THE OCCURRENCE COUNT BEFORE TRUSTING A RE-READ.**
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** When a function's contract is "snap to something valid", it can never RECOVER a value.
**⚠ A CONSTRAINT SATISFIED BY EVERY EXAMPLE IS NOT NECESSARILY THE CONSTRAINT.** All three original sizes were 64k-2; the real rule was only that *Slot* is 64-aligned.
**⚠ A RULE ENFORCED BY GREPPING A SYNTAX ONLY CATCHES THAT SYNTAX - PROVEN AGAIN.** Eight `- Slot` bugs were found by grepping `- Slot`. The ninth (§24b) is a terrain-def gate with no arithmetic in it, and no amount of grepping that string would ever have surfaced it. **A rule holds when the correct version is the only CONVENIENT one, not when it is greppable.**
**⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** "The cap derives from exactly one Slot below" sat in §6a as neutral architecture. It was also the reason rock vanished from +2 - a fact nobody wrote down next to it. **Record the limitation beside the decision.**
**⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.** GL substitutes its own worker, so our patches never run - no error, no log line, no conflict warning.
**⚠ AND THE BUG AFTER THAT IS USUALLY A COLLABORATION.** Two locally-correct behaviours composing badly. **When neither side is wrong, look at the ORDER.**
**⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT.** §23: two of three requested compat targets were already fully supported, one documented against a numbered run. **Grep the mod's NAME in your own source first.**
**⚠ A SHARED METHOD NAME IS A HYPOTHESIS, NOT A CONFLICT.** False-positive rate 50%; ReGrowth cleared four times.
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Design for the foreign patch you have not met.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ The thing you rounded away may be load-bearing.** **⚠ Duplication is how an invariant dies.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.** **⚠ A finding scoped to vanilla does not transfer to mods.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE virtual everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader**. Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. Never put a foreign type in a patch signature - type `__instance` as `object`. **Suppress the callee, not the caller.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Repair a foreign method's output rather than reimplementing it.** **Never clamp a Def field to fix one map.** **Prefer a published ExtensionPoint over racing internals.** **Read the LIVE def field, never a baked copy, when a mod can rewrite it at runtime.**
**Engine facts.** `holdSnowOrSand` defaults TRUE. Draw order is material render QUEUE, not altitude. `Banded` is FALSE for all of map generation. `SectionLayer` subclasses auto-discovered on EVERY map. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread - generation latches must be `[ThreadStatic]`. Ore defs have no `naturalTerrain`. `CameraJumper.TryJump` and `MapDrawer.MapMeshDirty` return silently unless `ProgramState == Playing`. Humanlikes past `ZoomRootSize` 18 render from an atlas blit ignoring `PawnDrawParms.matrix`. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper than after `FinalizeInit`).** Harmony skips POSTFIXES when the original throws but always runs FINALIZERS; **a prefix returning false skips the original but POSTFIXES STILL RUN**; prefix and transpiler compose. **`FogGrid` and compressible things are flat per-cell arrays sized by `map.Area`.** **`WaterInfo.GetWaterMovement` indexes `x * map.Size.z + z`.** **TileMutatorDefs compete within a `categories` entry, so a mod can REPLACE a vanilla mutator.** **`ThingDef.graphic` is baked at PostLoad and never refreshed; `graphicData.Graphic` is lazily rebuilt from CURRENT graphicData - which is why runtime retexture mods work at all.**

---

# 15-19. QOL / WEATHER / SETTINGS / AUDIT / FOREIGN MODLIST
**15a.** Nothing may exist in the void - finders answer inside the surface band; a `GenSpawn.Spawn` prefix rewrites `loc`; a 120-tick sweep catches teleports and pre-fix saves.
**15b.** `CloseToEdge` measured against `map.Size`, so the surface band reported itself as inland everywhere. One prefix re-bases onto the band rect; eleven cold call sites inherit it. **ONE surface-edge finder**; a null dir means "any side, re-rolled" deliberately.
**15d.** Vanilla's no-build edge REMOVED - that strip is also what stops a colony sealing its map edge. **15e.** Drop pods fall through the levels.
**16.** `AB_OpenAir`/`AB_WallTop` set `holdSnowOrSand=false`. Melt per band rewrites the private `outdoorMeltAmount` on EVERY call; **ReGrowth transpiles the same method and composes.** Rejected: swapping `WeatherDef.Worker.overlays`, a global Def. Readout rebuilt from `TryGetTemperatureForCell` - `OutdoorTemp` is NEVER reached because outdoor cells still belong to a Room.
**17.** **⚠ The blank-tab bug:** content height from the previous frame's `CurHeight` is a SELF-SUSTAINING LATCH without a floor. **⚠ Draw the diagnostic OUTSIDE the thing being diagnosed.**
**18a.** State taken in a Prefix released in a Postfix - three instances; `ABAimAngle` swaps LIVE COMBAT STATE and opened with `patched = null`, DISCARDING a pending restore. All now `Finalizer`.
**18b.** The mirror: no `ProgramState` guard (~1.3M dead dispatches per 7-band carve), no ascent rule. **The mirror exists because of an earlier report of this same family** - "ground floor mineables disappear on floor 2" - caused then by stale meshes. §24b is the same SYMPTOM from a different cause; do not assume the mirror is at fault again without checking whether anything was dirtied at all.
**18e. CLOSED:** `ABCavernGen.Generate` bails immediately without Biomes! Caverns. Re-confirmed #231 and #237 (0.7/0.0 ms).
**19.** The 910-mod failure was **not us** - the NRE is thrown while EVALUATING ARGUMENTS to `GenerateMap`. Real cause 24 lines earlier: a NEGATIVE `startingPawnCount`; exactly two mods patch it.

---

# 20. COMPAT LIBRARY
**We load at #900, LAST.** Harmony precedence is by PRIORITY, not load order.

| Family | Certainty | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Grand Rivers / Epic Rivers | 98% | width clamp shipped - **inert under GL** |
| Geological Landforms | 90% | roof fix shipped (untested); rivers TABLED (§22) |
| ReGrowth 2 | 80% | **cleared four times** |
| Vanilla Landmarks Expanded | 90% | 2 shipped, rest inherit or inert |
| **Better Mountains** | 95% | **already fully supported (§23a)** |
| **Better Trees** | 60% | **unexamined gap (§23c)** |
| **Medieval Overhaul** | 90% | formations: §24a fixed, §24b shipped |
| Biomes! | 40% | least understood |
| Alpha Biomes | 50% | presumed Crater-class. No save-path hooks. |

## 20b. SHIPPED (none verified in play)
1. **`Patch_VEE_LoneIsland_ABBandLocal`** - their falloff centres on `map.Center` and both passes walk `map.AllCells` writing elevation 0 + deep ocean below 0.2. On 126x896 the island is a disc of r≈76 at z=448, so **every band except the middle becomes ocean, including the surface**.
2. **`Patch_VEE_Crater_*`** - no single sampling hook, so **wrap the three private noise fields** in `BandLocalModule`. ⚠ Stated cost: one property feeds both axes, so x jitter compresses too.
3. **`Patch_TileMutatorWorker_ABRiverWidth`** - clamps `RiverNode.width` to 22% of band height, at the producer.
4. **`Patch_GL_ABLandformRoofScope` + `Patch_RoofGrid_ABLandformSurfaceOnly`** - GL's roof sweep is ~800k `SetRoof` calls stamping surface roofs onto every band.

## 20c. CLEARED - do not re-flag without a new confound
ReGrowth wall-snow (vertex range); ReGrowth `Printer_Plane` (linked graphics only); ReGrowth `IsSaveCompressible` + `Mineable.ExposeData` (**`IsSpaceRock()`-gated**); GL `AdjustMineables`; GL priority 800; ReGrowth `DoCellSteadyEffects`/`GetDrawParms`/`GenSpawn.Spawn`; VEE's river family and wildlife mutators.

---

# 21. ⚠ OPEN: FOG AND ROCKS ON SAVE RELOAD (HELD)
**ELIMINATED:** `ABV2.*` leakage; save compressibility; roof collapse; `RebindAfterLoad` ordering; ReGrowth (space-rock-only); Alpha Biomes / Biomes! (no save-path hooks).
**⚠ THE SYMPTOM PAIR POINTS AT US.** Fog and natural rock are exactly the two things stored as flat per-cell arrays sized by `map.Area`. Everything else - pawns, furniture, **player-built walls** - saves individually.
**⚠ ONE LOAD, TWO QUESTIONS:** click a reappeared rock (selectable -> data, not -> rendering); check a player-built wall nearby (intact -> array desync, disturbed -> generation re-ran). **Did it reproduce on a light modlist?**
**⚠ §24b is a candidate explanation for part of it.** "Rocks regenerate on reload" and "rock only draws one level down" can look identical if the player changed level between observations. Re-check §21 after §24b is verified.

# 22. ⚠ TABLED: GL RIVERS
**Tabled at the user's call. NOT resolved - tabled with an unexplained contradiction.**
**Confirmed:** GL REPLACES vanilla river generation (`GL_River` etc. are `TileMutatorDef`s in the **`River` category** on `TileMutatorWorker_Landform`). **#231 proved it: `riverGraph: 0 node(s)`.** Every river patch we own is **inert** under GL.

# 24. MULTI-CELL AND MULTI-LEVEL MASS

## 24a. FIXED: MO formations drawn four times overlapping
`IsPrintAnchor` picks the first cell of a multi-cell thing whose viewing cell can see it - single-valued **only if every cell resolves to the same `drop`**. It does not: `drop` comes from `TryResolveVisibleBelow` PER VIEWING CELL, so two columns over one 2x2 object can descend different distances and each elect itself the anchor. Four cells, four anchors, four quads at the same `TrueCenter` - which is why it read as *overlapping* rather than offset.
**Fixed by deduping per THING per Regenerate pass**, not by changing the anchor rule: the rule has a real job (a thing whose origin cell is hidden but whose far corner is visible must still draw), and it is the drop-dependence that is unsound. O(1), correct under every drop layout, cannot regress the visible-corner case. **Never MO-specific** - any 2x2+ thing was exposed.

## 24b. ⚠ SHIPPED, UNVERIFIED: rock was only ever visible ONE level down
**Reported with screenshots:** at +1 rock renders but the colour shifts; at +2 the ground's rock is gone; at +3 the +1 rock is gone. Terrain, trees and grass keep rendering at every depth - **only the rock mass vanishes.**

**Two single-step assumptions stacking:**
1. `SectionLayer_ABMountainCap` derives from `-bands.Slot`, exactly ONE band down (its `groundOffset`). Correct for a sky band's own tapering mass.
2. `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`'s bridge to the cap fired only when `def == ABDefOf.AB_MountainTop` - the terrain WE give sky-band mass. **Ordinary ground rock carries its own rough-stone terrain and never matched**, so nothing drew ground rock beyond the cap's single step.

Hence: +1 shows the cap's *field + silhouette* (not the real sprite, so the colour shifts); +2 and +3 show nothing where rock should be.

**Fix:** the bridge already receives the true drop (`above.z - below.z`), so only the gate was wrong. It now also fires for rock-derived terrain when `drop > slot` - beyond the cap's reach. The `drop > slot` clause is load-bearing: at exactly one slot the cap already draws that mass, and firing unconditionally would double the lip and corner fillers on every mountain edge at +1. `EmitMassSilhouetteAt` self-guards (returns false when the cell has a mineable edifice whose own sprite draws the edge).

**⚠ THE NINTH SINGLE-STEP BUG, AND THE FIRST INVISIBLE TO THE AUDIT.** The other eight were `- Slot` arithmetic and were found by grepping that string. This one is a TERRAIN-DEF GATE with no arithmetic in it at all.

**Verification:** +1 must look UNCHANGED (no doubled lips or corner fillers); +2 and +3 must show rock instead of bare ground. Both halves matter - the fix is bounded by `drop > slot` precisely so the +1 case is provably untouched, and if +1 changes, that bound is wrong.
